name: com.raccoon.game-kit
description:
Raccoon game kit: Audio, GameService (Firebase, In-App Review), Haptic, Helpers, Localization, Purchase, Save.

Optional dependencies, install them to enable the module (without them the API compiles but does nothing). Toggle defines in Raccoon > GameKit Setup:
- Save: Newtonsoft JSON (com.unity.nuget.newtonsoft-json) -> USING_GAMESAVE (auto)
- Purchase: Unity IAP (com.unity.purchasing) -> USING_PURCHASE (auto)
- GameService: Firebase Analytics + Crashlytics -> USING_FIREBASE (manual), com.google.firebase.remote-config -> USING_REMOTECONFIG (auto), com.google.play.review -> USING_INAPPREVIEW (auto)
